iterations: Initial open-wrap/skirt witness points lay in front openings; use actual serialized overlap at the back. Claw points lay above root caps; interior points correct them. No collapsed native triangles or UV-cell overflow were found.
The shawl needed an actual inward translation to overlap the torso. Its revised interior witness passes neutral and posed checks.
Closed boots replace bare-toe geometry for Zapam Zucum; ten toe claws complete Caa Pora. Source backups retain the initial state.

Native views exposed thin male limbs and short straight hair/beards. Broader limb volumes and longer curved tapered locks follow the references. Zapam Zucum receives an ivory blouse, bare arms and raised hem exposing the existing boots.
The raised flounce required a new point inside both serialized cloth solids. A retained overlap search and independent final posed checks verify it.

Lower male beard locks initially entered the chest despite valid scalp-root contacts. Curving them over the torso corrects the native silhouette; inspect the final front/profile and action/rest captures.
reviewed: Final front/profile/rear, face/ear/hair/beard/clothing details, extreme stride, attack, pain, intermediate death and oblique lying poses; both presentation scenes per species.
qualifications: Stylized closed component anatomy, painted face detail, opaque hair/foliage and rigid fall/rest poses remain candidates. Fixed clothes do not add modular equipped inventory.

All unchanged native actor scale/collision, stats, combat, loot, identity and save fields remain authoritative. Reference metre dimensions, powers and campaign placements are not adopted. Wide silhouettes may exceed provisional collision.
